csv_project_name: Engineer for Sewer Division and Administration Facility
csv_scope_of_work: The City of La Vista, Nebraska s soliciting design consultant proposals for professional services to provide preliminary and final design phase services for the proposed Sewer Division and Administration Facility for the City of La Vista Public Works Department. The City of La Vista s Public Works Department provides the necessary maintenance, upkeep and construction oversight of the City s infrastructure through several divisions, including Buildings, Parks, Sewers, and Streets.The current Sewer Maintenance Facility is a cold storage building that was converted into a small office and maintenance workspace. The current facility is functionally obsolete, and not conducive tothe efficient operations of the Division. The Public Works Department has grown significantly and no longer has stuffiness office space for their current and projected staff of over 70 employees. This new facility aims to address both of these issues for the continued growth of the Department for the next 40 years.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
